newsitem.title: UK: TESCO OUSTS SAINSBURY AS TOP UK SUPERMARKET.
newsitem.headline: TESCO OUSTS SAINSBURY AS TOP UK SUPERMARKET.

text.p: Supermarket chain Tesco Plc has pushed back to the top of Britain's retail league in terms of sales, a leading analysis group said on Monday.
Corporate Intelligence on Retailing said Tesco's retail sales of 11.6 billion stg in the 1995/96 financial year put it ahead of rival J. Sainsbury Plc for the first time since 1986/87.
The analysis group said Tesco's lead had widened further this year, with sales of 13.03 billion stg oustripping Sainsbury's estimated turnover of 11.76 billion.

In its latest survey of Britain's retail industry, Corporate Intelligence said supermarket chains continued to dominate the top 20 by sales but clothing retailer Marks & Spencer Plc and chemists Boots Co Plc were third and eighth respectively.

Corporate Intelligence said optical retailer Sunglass Hut topped the fastest sales growth league in 1996. Four of the league's 10 members were sports retailers, helped by the current fashions for football shirts and training shoes.
